Maya (PM): short sync 1: need to finalize burst policy + autoscale safety band defaults for dedicated pools. legal wants launch bullets.
Drew (Eng): propose safety_band=14% and preempt_budget=8%. prefer staged preempt (soft reclaim -> hard evict).
Sam (SRE): ops asks for opt-in auto-preempt for enterprise by contract; default off. require reclaim_wait=25s and telemetry: preempt_count, p95_preempt_latency, resume_kv_miss.
Irene (Legal): will draft opt-in/out clause and required notice windows for scheduled evictions. emergency evict ok with logging.
Drew (Eng): config sketch:
````
reserved_pools:
  safety_band_pct: 14
  preempt_budget_pct: 8
  reclaim_wait_seconds: 25
  auto_preempt_default: false
````
Maya (PM): launch checklist: policy + routing, console opt-in UI, telemetry dashboards, legal clause, run 2 pilots (one latency-critical, one bursty).
ux-bot: note created TICKET-CAP-8810 assigned to @Drew.
Maya (PM): action items: Drew RFC + PR, Sam dashboards, Irene contract blurb, I'll coordinate pilots. Drop blockers here. :white_check_mark:
